summary: Sourced complaints centre on district-level flood-damaged and jam-prone roads, government hospital charges and cane dues, while the city's main-road congestion rests on a 2018 report; most positives are unsourced inference.

positives.english: Cane mills crushing on time means money reaches farm families
positives.hindi: *मिलें समय पर चलें तो गन्ने का पैसा घर तक आता है
positives.basis: Inference: no AC-specific positive was sourced; general district farm-economy pattern. Cane dues are a recurring complaint (see negative 4).

positives.english: The district medical college offers a major government hospital option
positives.hindi: *शेख-उल-हिंद मेडिकल कॉलेज से बड़े सरकारी इलाज की उम्मीद है
positives.basis: Inference: not verified from an opened source in this session; a Lok Sabha record describes the college as the main government facility for the division, undated.

positives.english: The highway widening should ease travel through the city
positives.hindi: *हाईवे चौड़ा हो रहा है, शहर से गुजरने में आसानी होगी
positives.basis: Inference: a 2018 Patrika report describes the Saharanpur-Delhi road widening and power-line shifting through the city; completion status is not confirmed.

positives.english: Water left by the Hindon has receded and traffic has resumed
positives.hindi: हिंडन का पानी उतरा तो वाहन फिर चलने लगे
positives.basis: Amar Ujala 4 Aug 2026: Hindon water level fell and traffic resumed on the Sundarpur-Shakambhari Devi road in Chhutmalpur (district-level; Chhutmalpur not confirmed as Nagar AC).

positives.english: Municipal drives have cleared some encroachments on main roads
positives.hindi: *नगर निगम ने कुछ सड़कों से अतिक्रमण हटाने का अभियान चलाया
positives.basis: Inference: a June 2026 anti-encroachment drive appeared in a search result, but the page returned HTTP 403 and was not opened, so it is not cited.

negatives.english: Government hospital doctors charge for surgery and medicines come from outside
negatives.hindi: सरकारी अस्पताल में ऑपरेशन के पैसे लगते हैं, दवा बाहर से लानी पड़ती है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala video (22 Jan 2025): Bharatiya Kisan Union (Tomar) protest at the CMO office alleged illegal charges for surgeries at the district hospital and medicines arranged from outside. District-level; these are the union's allegations as reported.

negatives.english: A broken-down truck on the Hindon bridge causes hour-long jams
negatives.hindi: हिंडन पुल पर ट्रक खराब हो जाए तो घंटे भर का जाम लगता है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala video (21 Mar 2025): a truck broke down on the Hindon river bridge on the Saharanpur-Dehradun road near the police station; jam lasted about one hour as vehicles were left skewed across the lane. District-level; exact AC not confirmed.

negatives.english: Water has receded but the damaged road troubles small-vehicle drivers
negatives.hindi: हिंडन का पानी उतरा, पर टूटी सड़क से छोटी गाड़ी वालों की परेशानी
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala 4 Aug 2026: flooding damaged the Sundarpur-Shakambhari Devi road in Chhutmalpur; motorcyclists and small-car drivers struggle most when crossing the river. District-level; Chhutmalpur not confirmed as Nagar AC.

negatives.english: Sugar mills still owe cane dues and farmers keep waiting for payment
negatives.hindi: चीनी मिलों पर गन्ने का बकाया, किसान भुगतान का इंतजार करते हैं
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala 3 Jun 2021 (dated; current 2026 status not found): district mills paid Rs 100.34 crore in one day but Rs 630 crore in cane price arrears was still pending. District-level.

negatives.english: Delhi road runs through the city with no ring road, crowding the markets
negatives.hindi: शहर के बीच से दिल्ली रोड गुजरती है, रिंग रोड नहीं, बाज़ार में भीड़
negatives.basis: Patrika 19 Apr 2018 (dated): the Saharanpur-Delhi highway runs through the middle of the city because there is no ring road; the Hasanpur Chowk to Ghantaghar stretch via Court Road, described as the main market area. City-level; current conditions not confirmed.

notes: Identity confirmed from Wikipedia list (AC 3, Saharanpur Nagar, district Saharanpur, reserved None) and the Saharanpur Nagar AC Wikipedia page (Saharanpur Nagar Palika; created 2008; incumbent Rajiv Gumber, BJP, elected 2022). Weak coverage: no 2024-2026 Nagar-AC-specific civic complaint was opened and fetched. Negatives 1-3 are district-level (Amar Ujala); negative 5 and the 2018 Patrika widening source are dated. Negative 4 is a 2021 source. Positives 1, 2, 5 are unsourced inference (marked with *). Not cited because not opened: Newstrack 3 Jun 2026 encroachment drive (HTTP 403); Amar Ujala undated drain-cleaning item for 301 drains; Amar Ujala 2026-07-08 election piece (politics, no issues). Patrika 2018 power-cut report is stale, used only for the widening/Court Road context. Field-check priorities: Ghantaghar and Court Road congestion, Hasanpur Chowk widening status, Nagar Nigam waterlogging and drain cleaning, Saharanpur Nagar colony water supply, and whether the Hindon bridge and Chhutmalpur road fall inside Nagar AC. Web search budget ran out during the session, so local Hindi searches on water, sewage, stray cattle, and 2025-26 cane dues could not be completed.
